narratives.Overview:
- Add `json` to `vitest.config.ts` `coverage.reporter` (keep text / text-summary). Confirm `coverage/coverage-final.json` exists after a coverage run and `readCoverageTotalsFromReport` returns totals.
- At the release Step 5 classify call in `pipeline.ts`, populate `failedTests` (or equivalent sanitized gate) so a vitest assertion failure cannot reach `BRANCH_HAIRLINE` / `pass_with_debt`. Do not pass raw suite bytes as `reason` (#3282); if a tail is used, bound it through `extractGateCause`.
- Keep `COVERAGE_GOAL` at 85 unless #3512 records otherwise. Hairline only when a metric is below the vitest floor (75) as well. Do not treat API inventory of `failedTests` on `classifyStep5Failure` as a closed boundary until the pipeline call site wires the count.
- After json lands: debt teardown must not throw on missing report following a coverage run; `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` must complete; auto-hatch must see real totals. `coverage:hotspots` and `verify:forward-coverage` diff half consume the produced report as the post-coverage happy path (missing-report skip is no longer that happy path).
- Green-path stamp mtime (`suiteBoundMtime`, strict `>`) may be used once the file exists; carry or replace `seams.readCoverageTotals` escape; named stderr when the guard declines. Do not close #3512. Out of scope: #4230 hang supervisor; unifying goal to 75 without #3512 decision; stamp provenance schema.

## Verdict on the refutation-target

The Stop 1 refutation-target does **not** survive at the dispatch SHA. Pin-reads at `5c61e03b33ed274e424b1925bb35d8f55b552a45` confirm P1–P3 as live gaps. The design still needs the issue-body one-PR producer + classify wiring + consumer happy-path repair.

## Findings

### F1. coverage.reporter still omits json — no coverage-final.json producer

Evidence: `git show 5c61e03b33ed274e424b1925bb35d8f55b552a45:vitest.config.ts` has `reporter: ["text", "text-summary"]` under `coverage`. No `json` entry. `readCoverageTotalsFromReport` (`packages/core/src/vitest-runner/coverage-debt.ts`) joins `coverageDir` + `coverage-final.json` and returns null on miss. Without the reporter, a coverage run never writes that file.

Failure mode: hatch / hotspots / forward-coverage / debt teardown keep reading a file that a tip coverage run does not produce. The first clause of the refutation-target ("reporter already includes json") is false on this SHA.

Disposition: keep Stop 1 next-build item (1) — add `json` to `coverage.reporter` and confirm the file exists after a coverage run. Binding a lean that treats the producer as already landed would bind a false premise.
blocks-the-design

### F2. Release classify call site never populates failedTests

Evidence: `classifyStep5Failure` in `packages/core/src/release/auto-hatch.ts` accepts `failedTests` and returns `REAL_FAILURE` when `failedTests > 0`. Pin-read of `packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts` at the same SHA shows **zero** `failedTests` occurrences. The live Step 5 call is:

```
classifyStep5FailureWithFreshness({
  output: reason,
  totals,
  exitCode,
  timedOut: ...,
  coverageReportMtimeMs: suiteBoundMtime,
  nowMs: Date.now(),
})
```

No failed-test count is passed. `REAL_FAILURE_PATTERNS` can still catch rich output (`\d+ failed`, `AssertionError`, …), but the issue's thin `task check failed (exit N)` reason path is exactly what `failedTests` was meant to close. Once json lands and hairline totals exist, a vitest assertion failure with thin reason can still classify `BRANCH_HAIRLINE` and reach `pass_with_debt`.

Failure mode: second clause of the refutation-target ("classify already populates failedTests") is false at the call boundary that matters.

Disposition: keep Stop 1 item (2) — populate `failedTests` (or equivalent sanitized gate) at the release classify boundary without raw suite bytes as `reason` (#3282).
blocks-the-design

### F3. Consumers treat missing report as skip/throw/UNKNOWN — not a produced-report happy path

Evidence (same SHA):
- `coverage-debt-teardown.ts`: `if (totals === null) throw new Error("coverage-debt: could not read coverage/coverage-final.json")` under `--allow-coverage-debt=#N`.
- `coverage-hotspots/evaluate.ts`: missing `coverage-final.json` → configError asking the operator to run coverage first.
- `forward-coverage/diff-coverage.ts`: missing report → `emptyReport(..., reportPresent: false)` skip; `evaluate.ts` documents "Missing coverage reports skip the diff half".
- `auto-hatch.ts`: no totals → classifier falls through to `UNKNOWN`; `evaluateAutoHatch` fail-closes when classification is not `BRANCH_HAIRLINE`, and also refuses `BRANCH_HAIRLINE without measurable totals`.

Failure mode: third clause of the refutation-target ("already consume that produced report as the happy path") confuses reader presence with a live producer. After a tip coverage run, the happy path is still missing-report skip / throw / UNKNOWN, matching P3.

Disposition: keep Stop 1 items (4)–(5) — repair teardown after json lands; hotspots and forward-coverage diff half must consume the produced report as the post-coverage happy path.
blocks-the-design

### F4. Classifier support for failedTests is inventory, not a closed boundary

Evidence: `ClassifyStep5FailureInput.failedTests` and the `failedTests > 0 → REAL_FAILURE` branch exist in `auto-hatch.ts`, and `COVERAGE_GOAL` remains 85 on all four metrics in `coverage-debt.ts`. That is useful inventory for the fix shape; it does not close P2 until `pipeline.ts` wires the count.

Failure mode: mistaking API surface for call-site population would under-scope the PR.
sharpens-framing

### F5. Injection / swarm lens

Target is reporter config + release classify wiring + local report readers. No authority change, untrusted prompt/envelope, identity, or worktree concurrency surface in this residual. Lens: light / N/A for the producer gap itself; release Step 5 remains the concurrency-adjacent surface already scoped by #3187/#3282 sanitizer rules in the next-build contract.
footnote

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanned "already fixed on tip" by re-checking reporter, pipeline `failedTests`, and consumer miss paths at the pinned SHA rather than trusting the issue body's historical measurement SHA `7236655e`. Tip still matches the problem statement. What would flip: a pin-read showing `json` in `coverage.reporter` **and** a non-null `failedTests:` at the pipeline classify call **and** teardown/hotspots/forward-coverage treating a post-coverage report as present. None of those three hold here.

## Pains census (Stop 1)

- P1 confirmed (F1)
- P2 confirmed (F2)
- P3 confirmed (F3)

metadata.issueBody:
Residual of #4230 (operator lock: fork (b)). #4230 does **not** add a json coverage reporter. This issue is the producer that hatch, hotspots, and forward-coverage already assume.

Dispatch SHA for the measurement: `7236655ef6f586169c94f3c4ce5eeccf5668960b`.

## Problem

`vitest.config.ts` `coverage.reporter` is `["text", "text-summary"]` only. There is no `json` reporter, so a full `pnpm run test --coverage` / `ts:check-lane` never writes `coverage/coverage-final.json`.

Several shipped surfaces read that file with no fallback:

- `readCoverageTotalsFromReport` (`packages/core/src/vitest-runner/coverage-debt.ts`)
- coverage-debt teardown (`coverage-debt-teardown.ts`) throws `coverage-debt: could not read coverage/coverage-final.json` when `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` is set
- #3187 / #2866 auto-hatch (`release/auto-hatch.ts`) needs totals to classify `BRANCH_HAIRLINE`; missing totals classify UNKNOWN and fail closed — the hatch is inert
- `task coverage:hotspots` / `coverage-hotspots/evaluate.ts`
- `verify:forward-coverage` diff half (#3514) — missing report **skips** the diff half

#3514 closed the *code* for per-diff coverage. Without a producer, that compensating control is only half-live.

## Why this is not a #4230 item

#4230 fork (b) leaves the reporter alone on purpose. A failing suite already fail-closes (UNKNOWN). Adding `json` *creates* the hairline-to-debt path traced on #4230 (thin `task check failed (exit N)`, fresh `coverage-final.json`, branches in the 75–85 gap -> `BRANCH_HAIRLINE` -> `pass_with_debt`). That hole must be closed in **this** PR, not left for a later drive-by.

#3512 stays open on its own remainder (TypeScript recommendation, scaffold, vitest pin, decision record). Do not close #3512 here. Do not set `COVERAGE_GOAL` to 75 unless that decision is recorded on #3512; default is keep goal 85 and floor-gate hairline.

## Next-build contract — one PR

1. Add `json` to `coverage.reporter` (keep `text` / `text-summary` if operators still need the printed summary). Confirm `coverage/coverage-final.json` exists after `pnpm exec vitest run --coverage` on a small path.
2. Populate `failedTests` at the release classify boundary so a vitest **test** failure cannot reach `BRANCH_HAIRLINE`. Do **not** pass raw suite bytes as `reason` (#3282 env-leak). If a tail is used, it is bounded and goes through `extractGateCause` sanitizer.
3. Keep `COVERAGE_GOAL` at 85 unless #3512 records otherwise. Hairline only when a metric is below the vitest floor (75) as well. Do not treat goal/floor alignment as a substitute for (2).
4. Repair the hatch path: teardown must not throw on a missing report after json lands; `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` must be able to complete; auto-hatch must see real totals.
5. `coverage:hotspots` and `verify:forward-coverage` diff half read the produced report. Missing-report skip is no longer the happy path after a coverage run.
6. Green-path stamp mtime (`suiteBoundMtime`, strict `>`) may be used once the file exists; carry or replace the `seams.readCoverageTotals` escape; named stderr when the guard declines.

## Acceptance

- [ ] After a coverage run, `coverage/coverage-final.json` exists and `readCoverageTotalsFromReport` returns totals.
- [ ] A vitest assertion failure at release Step 5 cannot stamp `pass_with_debt` (`failedTests` or equivalent; not raw suite bytes in `reason`).
- [ ] `--allow-coverage-debt=#N` no longer throws on missing `coverage-final.json` after a coverage run.
- [ ] `task coverage:hotspots` and `verify:forward-coverage` (diff half) consume the produced report.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry.
- [ ] #3512 not closed by this PR.

## Out of scope

#4230 hang supervisor, one-suite skill edit, full-mode pin. Closing #3512. Unifying `COVERAGE_GOAL` to 75 unless that decision is already on #3512. Stamp provenance schema.

## Refs

#4230 (parent; fork (b) residual). #3187, #2866, #2573, #3514, #3512, #3282, #2683, #1310.
Files: `vitest.config.ts`, `packages/core/src/vitest-runner/coverage-debt.ts`, `packages/core/src/vitest-runner/coverage-debt-teardown.ts`, `packages/core/src/release/auto-hatch.ts`, `packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts`, `packages/core/src/coverage-hotspots/evaluate.ts`, `packages/core/src/forward-coverage/evaluate.ts`, `content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md`, `docs/RELEASING.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
